title: GPT-6 Astra on OpenRouter
summary: GPT-6 Astra is OpenAI's latest flagship model now accessible through OpenRouter, a unified API gateway that aggregates multiple LLM providers offering competitive pricing, rate limits, and model routing capabilities for developers.
problem_solved: Provides developers a single API interface to access GPT-6 Astra and other AI models without managing multiple provider accounts and configurations.
why_valuable: Simplifies AI model integration and enables easy comparison/switching between providers for better cost efficiency and performance optimization.
